title: Exam structure and context review and design: hierarchy, instruction inheritance, shared references, cross-page, validation, parsing metrics (REQ-0073)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 deliverables A-G in one design

design.summary: Exam structure and scoped context: probe-confirmed defects (instruction carry-over across restart, deleted own override, A./B. lines read as options); stage 1 = 65.1 section-scoped ranges, 65.2 own override, 65.6 labelled option scan, 65.8 structure flags; parsing score kept apart from solving

implementation.summary: stage 1+: 65.1 section-scoped ranges, 65.2 own override, 65.3 range word case, 65.5 enumerated headings + section stack, 65.6 labelled option scan, 65.8 structure flags (assembly rows + ingest WARN); Section lines in labelled output keep their parent heading (named golden update)

unit_test.result: 1280 tests, only baseline failures; 35 structure tests; probe P1..P11 fixed; golden byte-identical on 114 md inputs + 3 plans/dgnl-window files, DGNL refined3 differs only in 4 Section lines per prompt; 79-case bank sweep loses no choice text and keeps ABCD for blank-line banks; 6/6 mutations killed; D1-D6 fixed over 2 rounds, D7 known limit

user_notes.note: brief tmp/Exam-Structure-Context.md: review/gaps/design/best solution; no implementation before design accepted
